properties.text: RichText - remote images. Fetching an image tells its host the document was shown, and the URL can carry data, so Markdown from a model or an agent should not fetch on its own. Each example uses its own image, since an image already in the shared cache shows in every mode.
remoteImages "automatic" (the default): the image is fetched as soon as the document renders.

A remote image, fetched from picsum.photos:

An inline data: image, always shown: ![gradient](data:image/png;base64,)

properties.text: remoteImages "on-click": a placeholder names the image's host; click it to fetch that one image.
